title: mailbox.rs: Mailbox/get,changes,query,queryChanges,set
description:
Implement all 5 Mailbox/* handler functions in src/mailbox.rs.

## Methods to implement
- Mailbox/get (RFC 8621 §2.1): fetch mailboxes by id list or all; honor 'properties' filter
- Mailbox/changes (RFC 8621 §2.2): return created/updated/destroyed since sinceState
- Mailbox/query (RFC 8621 §2.3): filter+sort mailbox list; FilterCondition fields: parentId, name, role, hasAnyRole, isSubscribed
- Mailbox/queryChanges (RFC 8621 §2.4): removed + added items since sinceState
- Mailbox/set (RFC 8621 §2.5):
  - create: parentId validation, role uniqueness check (only one Inbox, one Drafts, etc.)
  - update: patch semantics via JSON Merge Patch
  - destroy: onDestroyRemoveEmails flag — if false and mailbox non-empty → mailboxHasEmail error; if true, delete contained emails first (handler layer, not backend)
  - Singleton mailboxes (Inbox) cannot be destroyed → forbidden error

## Key design decisions
- onDestroyRemoveEmails logic lives entirely in handler, not backend
- Role uniqueness (at most one mailbox per role per account) enforced in handler
- Backend sees only get_objects/set_object calls

## Source references

## Test vectors (MemoryBackend integration tests)
- Create mailbox → get → assert fields match
- Set with onDestroyRemoveEmails=false on non-empty mailbox → expect mailboxHasEmail error
- Set with onDestroyRemoveEmails=true → emails deleted, mailbox destroyed
- Mailbox/query with parentId filter → only child mailboxes returned
